  html:
    embed-resources: true

      - text: |
          <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega@6"></script>
          <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-lite@6"></script>
          <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-embed@7"></script>
          <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xterm@4/css/xterm.css"/>

```{r}
#| echo: false
visual <- "VISUALISE bill_length_mm AS x, flipper_length_mm AS y, species AS color
DRAW point
LABEL title => 'Bill Length vs Flipper Length'"

# Embeds SVG output as <img src="data:..."> so the SVG's internal CSS
# (font-family, fill) cannot bleed into the surrounding document.
svg_img <- function(format) {
  lines <- system2(
    "bash",
    c("-c", shQuote(paste(
      "duckdb < penguins.sql 2>/dev/null",
      "| ./bin/duckpipe --format", format, "--visual", shQuote(visual)
    ))),
    stdout = TRUE
  )
  b64 <- base64enc::base64encode(charToRaw(paste(lines, collapse = "\n")))
  cat(sprintf('<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64,%s" style="width:100%%;display:block">\n', b64))
}

# The SVG <img> above has no text content the browser can select/copy (it's
# a rasterized-looking vector image, opaque to the page). This fetches the
# same picture's colour-stripped plain-text form (--format text /
# braille-text) and wires up a "Copy as text" button for it via a hidden
# <pre> holding the real characters.
copy_button <- function(format) {
  lines <- system2(
    "bash",
    c("-c", shQuote(paste(
      "duckdb < penguins.sql 2>/dev/null",
      "| ./bin/duckpipe --format", format, "--visual", shQuote(visual)
    ))),
    stdout = TRUE
  )
  txt <- paste(lines, collapse = "\n")
  esc <- gsub("&", "&amp;", txt, fixed = TRUE)
  esc <- gsub("<", "&lt;", esc, fixed = TRUE)
  esc <- gsub(">", "&gt;", esc, fixed = TRUE)
  slug <- gsub("[^a-z]+", "-", format)
  details_id <- paste0("actions-", slug)
  btn_id <- paste0("copybtn-", slug)
  pre_id <- paste0("copytext-", slug)
  # Same vega-embed-style "..." actions menu (<details>/<summary> with the
  # three-dot SVG icon) that duckpipe's own xterm.js snippets use, kept
  # visually consistent across every "Copy as text" affordance on the page.
  cat(sprintf('<details id="%s" style="position:relative;display:inline-block;margin-bottom:4px;">
<summary style="list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:28px;height:22px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:4px;background:#fff;color:#434a56;" title="Actions"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" width="14" height="14"><circle r="2" cy="8" cx="2"></circle><circle r="2" cy="8" cx="8"></circle><circle r="2" cy="8" cx="14"></circle></svg></summary>
<div style="position:absolute;z-index:1000;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.2);border-radius:4px;padding:6px 0;margin-top:4px;min-width:140px;"><a href="#" id="%s" style="display:block;padding:4px 12px;color:#434a56;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;font:13px sans-serif;">Copy as text</a></div>
</details>
<style>#%s summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}</style>
', details_id, btn_id, details_id))
  cat(sprintf('<pre id="%s" hidden>%s</pre>\n', pre_id, esc))
  cat(sprintf('<script>
(function(){
  var btn=document.getElementById("%s");
  var pre=document.getElementById("%s");
  var details=document.getElementById("%s");
  btn.addEventListener("click", function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    if(details){details.open=false;}
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(pre.textContent).then(function(){
      var orig=btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent="Copied!";
      setTimeout(function(){btn.textContent=orig;},1500);
    });
  });
})();
</script>
', btn_id, pre_id, details_id))
}

# The DuckDB ggsql *extension* (a community extension, `INSTALL ggsql FROM
# community`) is a separate implementation from the standalone ggsql CLI/
# container duckpipe wraps above — it runs the ggsql query in-process via a
# scalar `ggsql()` function, with `ggsql_output = 'html'` producing a fully
# self-contained HTML document (vega/vega-lite/vega-embed bundled inline,
# no CDN dependency at all — verified to render fully offline). This
# assumes the extension is already installed locally; unlike duckpipe's
# formats it isn't driven through podman/vl-convert at all.
ggsql_ext_html <- function() {
  csv_tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
  system2("bash", c("-c", paste("duckdb < penguins.sql >", shQuote(csv_tmp))))

  query <- paste0("SELECT * FROM read_csv('", csv_tmp, "', header=true)\n", visual)
  # Escape single quotes so `query` can be embedded inside a SQL '...' string
  # literal (the ggsql() call argument) without breaking out of it.
  query_escaped <- gsub("'", "''", query, fixed = TRUE)

  html_tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".html")
  sql_tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".sql")
  writeLines(c(
    "LOAD ggsql;",
    "SET ggsql_output = 'html';",
    sprintf(
      "COPY (SELECT ggsql('%s')) TO '%s' (FORMAT CSV, HEADER false, QUOTE '');",
      query_escaped, html_tmp
    )
  ), sql_tmp)
  system2("duckdb", character(0), stdin = sql_tmp, stdout = FALSE, stderr = FALSE)

  html <- paste(readLines(html_tmp, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
  b64 <- base64enc::base64encode(charToRaw(html))
  cat(sprintf(
    '<iframe src="data:text/html;base64,%s" style="width:100%%;height:600px;border:1px solid #ddd;" title="ggsql extension standalone export"></iframe>\n',
    b64
  ))
}
```

## Interactive

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
html <- system2(
  "bash",
  c("-c", shQuote(paste(
    "duckdb < penguins.sql 2>/dev/null",
    "| ./bin/duckpipe --format html-body --visual", shQuote(visual)
  ))),
  stdout = TRUE
)
cat(paste(html, collapse = "\n"))
```

## Terminal (ANSI blocks)

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
svg_img("svg")
copy_button("text")
```

## Terminal (braille)

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
svg_img("braille-svg")
copy_button("braille-text")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Emits an xterm.js <div>+<script> fragment. xterm.js must already be loaded
# globally (via include-in-header) since this isn't a standalone page.
xterm_html <- function(format) {
  lines <- system2(
    "bash",
    c("-c", shQuote(paste(
      "duckdb < penguins.sql 2>/dev/null",
      "| ./bin/duckpipe --format", format, "--visual", shQuote(visual)
    ))),
    stdout = TRUE
  )
  cat(paste(lines, collapse = "\n"))
}
```

## Terminal (xterm.js, ANSI blocks)

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
xterm_html("xterm")
```

## Terminal (xterm.js, braille)

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
xterm_html("braille-xterm")
```

## DuckDB ggsql extension (standalone HTML)

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
ggsql_ext_html()
```
